description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 23.05.2016 to 29.05.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically modifying how customs calculations are performed. The content involves legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
